title: A country's climate profiles
description: The frost dates, the hardiness zone and the length of the season at each place of a country, which a household's place resolves to and its crops' timings are counted from (PRD 11, FR-GA3). One file per country, garden/climate/<code>.json. A member may edit every value: they know their own frost pocket better than a dataset does.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, and the file's name: a country that has a profile in countries/.

monthDay.description: A day of the year as MM-DD: a normal of thirty years, which belongs to no one year.

key.description: The place's key, its country's code and its name: unique among every country's places, and the one field without a source.

name.description: The place's own name, as its country writes it, the same in every language.

location.description: Where the place is, in degrees to two decimal places, the precision a household's own place is stored at (PRD 05 §2).

altitude_m.description: The altitude the values hold at, in metres above sea level: that of the source's grid cell, which is not the place's own where the land around it rises or falls.

last_spring_frost.description: The day after which a frost comes in one spring in ten.

first_autumn_frost.description: The day before which a frost comes in one autumn in ten.

hardiness_zone.description: The USDA plant hardiness zone, from the mean of each year's lowest temperature.

season_length_days.description: The days from the last spring frost to the first autumn frost.
